sections.title: Fuel standards overview
sections.content:
## Purpose

Fuel standards declare the standard fuel consumption for each vehicle. The system uses this data to calculate and cross-check fuel costs.

## Access

**Menu:** Driver salary > Configuration > Fuel standards

![](/uploads/b7f03d499f1e5ed45e6dae45.png)

The list shows the effective date, the standard (litres / 100 km) and the vehicle it applies to.

sections.title: Creating a fuel standard
sections.content:
### Step 1

Click **New**.

![](/uploads/82d250823a94b8089c866269.png)

### Step 2

Declare the standard information.

![](/uploads/c834174054212a038b7dee0d.png)

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Effective date | Date the standard starts applying. |
| Standard (litres / 100 km) | Standard fuel consumption. |
| Vehicle | Vehicle the fuel standard applies to. If left empty, the system applies the current standard to every vehicle by default. |

### Step 3

Click **Save manually** to save.

![](/uploads/027af43e4c0f6e0acf5067d0.png)

The result after saving:

![](/uploads/1645fd8d675b17c22b93b702.png)
